servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Auto Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Auto Tensioner / Idler Pulley Removal and Installation:K12C-ISG

servinfo.ptxt: Check the following points. If check result is not OK, replace accessory drive belt auto tensioner (1) and/or idler pulley (3).

item.ptxt: Turn accessory drive belt auto tensioner pulley (2) and drive belt idler pulley and check that each pulley rotates smoothly without any abnormal noise.
Check damage on accessory drive belt auto tensioner and idler pulley.
Check that there is no leakage of accessory drive belt auto tensioner oil.
